name: Admin View Map
description: Open the panel route inventory, filter grouped views, and copy route references for support and QA communication. Includes three complementary modes: Lista for the full inventory, Mapa for module cards and route drill-down, and Explorador for a contextual journey through three product spaces: Panel interno, Plataforma de clientes, and Experiencias públicas. The Explorer exposes representative modules and submodules, updates business and operational context on hover or focus, supports card navigation on compact viewports and an orbital layout from landscape upward, and offers free or guided navigation. Shareable state uses ?viewMode=explorer&node=<id>; guided tours add ?tour=<space-id> and preserve the current node when the user exits. It also supports slow automatic rotation, drag and keyboard controls, zoom, reduced-motion preferences, functional relations, and search. Ships seeded filter tabs (Admin, Público, Cliente, Dashboards, Configuración) and a Configuración section that persists the default view mode and default filters in the ViewMapSettings backend singleton; ?viewMode= overrides the configured default and localStorage no longer persists the last-used mode.
knownGaps: Configuración default-filters autosave (debounced PATCH + toast) and default-filters application on open are unit-covered only (2026-07 audit).
Saved-tab CRUD (create/rename/delete) unasserted on view_map; shared ProposalFilterTabs component is exercised in proposals specs (2026-07 audit).
